shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the reciprocal developmental pathways for the generation of pathogenic effector TH17 cells and regulatory T cells, particularly in the context of autoimmune inflammation, interleukin-23, psoriasis, and the role of cytokines such as TGF-ß.

shelves.name: Psychedelics and Drug Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the therapeutic potential of psychedelic therapy, particularly focusing on the use of substances like psilocybin and MDMA for the treatment of depression, anxiety, and substance dependence.

shelves.name: Psychiatric care and mental health services
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the implementation, effectiveness, and impact of crisis resolution and home treatment teams in mental health care.

shelves.name: Psychiatry, Mental Health, Neuroscience
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of neuroscience, symbolic information processing, and automation in robotics.

shelves.name: Psychoanalysis and Psychopathology Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to psychodynamic psychotherapy, developmental trauma, attachment, mental health, and the parent-infant relationship.

shelves.name: Psychoanalysis and Social Critique
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics including psychoanalysis, social theory, religion, gender studies, philosophy, ethics, sociology, literature analysis, political science, and history.

shelves.name: Psychoanalysis, Philosophy, and Politics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of psychoanalysis and politics, delving into topics such as subjectivity, desire, ethics, resistance, and the influence of capitalism and neoliberalism.

shelves.name: Psychodrama and Leishmaniasis Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to diversity, inclusion, and education, including studies on gender, obesity, the elderly, and the impact of COVID-19.

shelves.name: Psycholinguistics and Behavioral Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the components of Education 4.0, focusing on topics such as 21st Century Skills Frameworks, distance learning, teacher training, psychological safety, digital technology, STEM education, inclusive education, pedagogical skills, biomedical science, and global education.

shelves.name: Psychological and Educational Research Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the psychology of curiosity, encompassing topics such as epistemic curiosity, exploration, learning, interest, and their implications for psychological well-being, education, motivation, and emotional development.

shelves.name: Psychological and Temporal Perspectives Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the conceptualization and measurement of time perspective, including future orientation, well-being, health behavior, adolescent development, self-control, motivation, personality traits, academic engagement, and socioeconomic disparities.

shelves.name: Psychological Testing and Assessment
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on psychological assessment methods, particularly the use of projective techniques like the Rorschach Comprehensive System, to explore implicit motives such as achievement motivation.

shelves.name: Psychological Treatments and Assessments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy (REBT) and its applications in addressing irrational beliefs, psychological distress, stress management, and mental health issues.

shelves.name: Psychological Treatments and Disorders
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to mental health, psychoanalysis, psychiatry, and the study of emotions.

shelves.name: Psychological Well-being and Life Satisfaction
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the role of positive emotions, well-being, and mental health, encompassing topics such as positive psychology, happiness, subjective well-being, resilience, gratitude, and eudaimonia.

shelves.name: Psychology and Mental Health
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers encompasses a wide range of topics related to psychoanalysis, mental health, clinical practice, social determinants of mental health, diagnostic labels in depression, parenting, adolescence, and qualitative research methods in psychopathology.

shelves.name: Psychology of Development and Education
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores various aspects of psychology in education, focusing on topics such as the Zone of Proximal Development, inclusive education, cultural-historical theory, educational environment, psychological well-being, teacher training, learning motivation, adolescent development, social cognition, and digital learning.

shelves.name: Psychology of Moral and Emotional Judgment
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the neuroscience and psychology of moral judgment, with a focus on the role of disgust, emotion, and disease avoidance in ethical decision-making.

shelves.name: Psychology of Social Influence
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of social norms, particularly in the context of obedience, tipping behavior, and compliance with requests.

shelves.name: Psychology Research and Bibliometrics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the research methodology in psychology and education, including topics such as peer review process, bibliometric analysis of scientific publications, evaluation criteria for doctoral programs, and internationalization of psychology journals.

shelves.name: Psychology, Coaching, and Therapy
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of coaching, psychodrama, and professional development, focusing on the impact of coaching relationships, self-efficacy, personality match, and emotional regulation in workplace settings.

shelves.name: Psychometric Methodologies and Testing
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the topic of measurement invariance in structural equation modeling, exploring concepts such as factor analysis, latent class analysis, reliability estimation, model fit indices, Likert scales, Cronbach's alpha, item response theory, and cross-cultural research.

shelves.name: Psychopathy, Forensic Psychiatry, Sexual Offending
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the study of psychopathy and its association with criminal behavior, including risk assessment, mental disorders, violent recidivism, neurobiological basis, emotion recognition deficits, and treatment effectiveness.

shelves.name: Psychosocial Factors Impacting Youth
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the influence of multicultural factors, such as acculturation stress, parenting behavior, and social support, on the well-being and adjustment of adolescents.

shelves.name: Psychosomatic Disorders and Their Treatments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the study of interoception, the sense of the internal state of the body, and its association with somatic symptoms, including alexithymia, health anxiety, psychogenic nonepileptic seizures, and depersonalization disorder.

shelves.name: Psychotherapy Techniques and Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the therapeutic alliance in psychotherapy research, exploring its relation to psychotherapy outcome, evidence-based practice, and psychological interventions.

shelves.name: Public Administration and Governance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to public policy, governance, and political systems.

shelves.name: Public Administration and Political Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores various aspects of political governance, leadership, and public administration in modern societies.

shelves.name: Public Administration in Developing Nations
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on public policy and administration in developing nations, addressing issues such as policy implementation, community empowerment, social welfare, government reform, service quality, local governance, e-government, sustainable development, and social justice.

shelves.name: Public Administration, ICT, and Policy Development
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the development, impact, and coordination of economic clusters, including the role of logistics industry, innovation systems, and supply chains.

shelves.name: Public Health and Environmental Issues
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to public health, environmental management, and sustainable development.

shelves.name: Public Health and Nutrition
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on maternal and child health services, with an emphasis on preventing stunting and non-communicable diseases.

shelves.name: Public health and occupational medicine
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of global public goods, their management in the era of economic globalization, and their impact on international cooperation, health agenda, regional development, public services, environmental sustainability, and human rights.

shelves.name: Public Health and Social Inequalities
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of social determinants on health, including topics such as healthcare disparities, cultural variation in health experiences, maternal health, and community participation in promoting health.

shelves.name: Public Health in Brazil
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the judicialization of healthcare access in Brazil, particularly related to medication and the public health system.

shelves.name: Public Health Policies and Education
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to public health, health promotion, ethics, and the performance of health systems.

shelves.name: Public Policy and Administration Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of collaborative governance in public administration and management, focusing on topics such as public management reform, network management, public service motivation, co-production, performance measurement, policy implementation, stakeholder involvement, institutional theory, and public value.

shelves.name: Public Policy and Governance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to public policy, governance, institutions, and social participation in Latin America.

shelves.name: Public Procurement and Policy
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the role of public procurement in driving innovation, sustainability, and social outcomes.

shelves.name: Public Relations and Crisis Communication
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on crisis communication, particularly the use of social media, in managing and responding to various crises such as natural disasters, organizational crises, and public health emergencies.

shelves.name: Public Spaces through Art
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the complex dynamics of graffiti and street art in urban spaces, examining their role in negotiating urban landscapes, public expression, social resistance, and cultural heritage.

shelves.name: Public-Private Partnership Projects
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the evaluation, risk assessment, critical success factors, and governance of Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) and Private Finance Initiative (PFI) projects in infrastructure development.

shelves.name: Publishing and Scholarly Communication
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the evolution, challenges, and impact of scholarly publishing practices, including academic writing, university presses, open access, research dissemination, book publishing, editorial practices, digital monographs, publication ethics, and peer review.

shelves.name: Pulmonary Hypertension Research and Treatments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the diagnosis, assessment, and treatment guidelines for pulmonary hypertension, with an emphasis on right heart assessment using echocardiography.

shelves.name: Pulsars and Gravitational Waves Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the observation, study, and implications of gravitational waves from binary black hole and neutron star mergers, as well as the use of LIGO and Virgo detectors for these detections.

shelves.name: Pulsed Power Technology Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the technology and applications of pulsed power, including electron beam surface modification, high current systems, solid-state generators, high-power microwave sources, semiconductor switches, plasma sources, and radiography systems.

shelves.name: Q Methodology Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers revolves around the theory, method, and application of Q methodology in various research fields.

shelves.name: QR Code Applications and Technologies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the diverse applications of QR codes in fields such as mobile technology, education, security, and authentication.

shelves.name: Qualitative Comparative Analysis Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of Qualitative Comparative Analysis (QCA) and related set-theoretic methods in social science research.

shelves.name: Qualitative research in health
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on narrative research methods, biographical narratives, socialization theory, and qualitative research in the fields of social sciences and education.

shelves.name: Qualitative Research Methods and Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the development, application, and challenges of grounded theory methodology in qualitative research.

shelves.name: Qualitative Research Methods and Ethics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on qualitative research methods and ethics, with an emphasis on reflexivity, interpretative phenomenological analysis, interviewing techniques, translation challenges, researcher positionality, fieldwork experiences, and the ethical considerations of anonymity and participant observation.

shelves.name: Quality and Management Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the integration of various management systems, such as quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management, to improve organizational efficiency and sustainability.

shelves.name: Quality and Safety in Healthcare
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the maintenance and management of medical equipment in healthcare settings.

shelves.name: Quality and Supply Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on developing evidence-informed knowledge in the field of supply chain management.

shelves.name: Quality Function Deployment in Product Design
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the application of Quality Function Deployment (QFD) in product development, management, and service quality.

shelves.name: Quality of Life Measurement
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the assessment and measurement of quality of life, sustainable development, and socioeconomic progress in European Union countries.

shelves.name: Quantum and Classical Electrodynamics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers the foundations of electromagnetic theory, quantum field theory, and the behavior of light and electromagnetic forces in dielectric media.

shelves.name: Quantum and electron transport phenomena
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers advances in semiconductor spintronics, quantum computing, and mesoscopic systems.

shelves.name: Quantum chaos and dynamical systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the characterization and properties of chaotic quantum dynamics, including the study of Lagrangian coherent structures, semiclassical theory, level fluctuation laws, decoherence rates, and quantum resonances.

shelves.name: Quantum Chromodynamics and Particle Interactions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics in hadron physics and quantum chromodynamics (QCD), including the study of charmonium, mesons, baryons, parton distributions, exotic states, and the application of renormalization group techniques in lattice QCD.

shelves.name: Quantum Computing Algorithms and Architecture
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers represents a wide range of advancements in quantum computing and simulation, covering topics such as fault-tolerant quantum computation, quantum machine learning, adiabatic quantum computation, quantum error correction, and topological quantum memory.

shelves.name: Quantum Dots Synthesis And Properties
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the diverse applications of quantum dots and nanocrystals in various fields such as bioimaging, photovoltaics, fluorescence imaging, biological detection, and nanoparticle synthesis.

shelves.name: Quantum Electrodynamics and Casimir Effect
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the Casimir effect, quantum vacuum fluctuations, and related phenomena such as analogue gravity, dynamical Casimir effect, Hawking radiation, and van der Waals forces.

shelves.name: Quantum Information and Cryptography
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics in the field of quantum information, including quantum entanglement, cryptography, computation, metrology, superconducting circuits, photon manipulation, measurement, security, and communication.

shelves.name: Quantum many-body systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the dynamics and entanglement properties of quantum many-body systems, including topics such as many-body localization, quantum thermalization, matrix product states, topological order, quantum phase transitions, tensor networks, and the application of machine learning techniques.

shelves.name: Quantum Mechanics and Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the foundational aspects of quantum mechanics, including decoherence, Bell inequalities, quantum measurement, interpretations of quantum theory, weak values, entanglement, nonlocality, and the nature of quantum information.

shelves.name: Quantum Mechanics and Non-Hermitian Physics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of Parity-Time (PT) symmetry in optics and quantum mechanics, focusing on non-Hermitian physics, exceptional points, topological phases, and nonlinear systems.

shelves.name: Quantum optics and atomic interactions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the phenomenon of slow light propagation and quantum memory in coherent media, particularly using techniques such as electromagnetically induced transparency, optical quantum memory, and photon storage in atomic ensembles.

shelves.name: Quantum, superfluid, helium dynamics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the behavior of helium at ultra-low temperatures, focusing on quantum effects in helium nanodroplets and solids.

shelves.name: Quantum-Dot Cellular Automata
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the design, simulation, and implementation of Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) for molecular computing and nanotechnology applications.

shelves.name: Quasicrystal Structures and Properties
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the structure, properties, and applications of quasicrystals, including their formation, stability, atomic structure, and potential uses in photonics and plasmonics.

shelves.name: Quinazolinone synthesis and applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the chemistry, synthesis, and pharmacological properties of quinazoline compounds, including indirubin derivatives.

shelves.name: Qur’anic Interpretation Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to Islamic studies and education, including Qur'anic exegesis (Tafsir), Islamic law, gender in Islam, the integration of Islam with modern education, and the influence of Islamic teachings on various aspects of society.

shelves.name: Rabbits: Nutrition, Reproduction, Health
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the perception and factors influencing the quality of rabbit meat, including reproductive performance, dietary fiber, growth, carcass characteristics, microbiota, welfare, and nutrition.

shelves.name: Rabies epidemiology and control
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the epidemiology, transmission dynamics, control strategies, and host-pathogen interactions of the Rabies virus.

shelves.name: Race, Genetics, and Society
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the complex intersection of race and genetics in biomedical research, focusing on the impact of race and ethnicity on health disparities, genetic ancestry, epigenetics, and population genetics.

shelves.name: Race, History, and American Society
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of the Civil Rights Movement, Black Studies, and African American history.

shelves.name: Race, Identity, and Education in Brazil
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of racial discrimination, decolonial theory, and intersectionality in the context of Brazil.

shelves.name: Racial and Ethnic Identity Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of racial discrimination on health outcomes, focusing on topics such as acculturation, ethnic identity, structural racism, mental health, and the experiences of immigrant youth.

shelves.name: Radar Systems and Signal Processing
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the research and development of Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) radar systems, with an emphasis on waveform design, signal processing, cognitive radar, automotive radar applications, space-time adaptive processing, frequency diverse array antennas, joint radar-communication design, passive radar technology, and target detection and localization.

shelves.name: Radiation Detection and Scintillator Technologies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers advances in scintillation detector technology, including the development of inorganic scintillators, silicon photomultipliers, and their applications in medical imaging, radiation detection, and time-of-flight positron emission tomography (PET).

shelves.name: Radiation Dose and Imaging
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the health risks associated with radiation exposure from medical imaging, particularly computed tomography (CT) scans.

shelves.name: Radiation Effects and Dosimetry
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the history, current status, and future prospects of food irradiation, covering topics such as irradiation effects on food safety, EPR dosimetry for radiation detection, microbial decontamination, antioxidant activity, and consumer acceptance.

shelves.name: Radiation Effects in Electronics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the challenges and techniques for fault tolerance in electronic systems, particularly in the context of soft errors, radiation effects, and single event upsets in CMOS technology.

shelves.name: Radiative Heat Transfer Studies

shelves.name: Radical Photochemical Reactions

shelves.name: Radio Astronomy Observations and Technology

shelves.name: Radio Frequency Integrated Circuit Design
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the design and optimization of radio frequency integrated circuits (RF ICs) in CMOS technology, covering topics such as oscillators, low-noise amplifiers, millimeter-wave circuits, phase noise characterization, transceivers, inductors, and frequency synthesizers.

shelves.name: Radio Wave Propagation Studies

shelves.name: Radio, Podcasts, and Digital Media

shelves.name: Radioactive Decay and Measurement Techniques
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers revolves around the measurement and analysis of radionuclide decay rates, with a focus on techniques such as liquid scintillation counting, coincidence counting, and ionization chambers.

shelves.name: Radioactive element chemistry and processing
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the chemistry of actinide and lanthanide elements, particularly uranium, and their interactions with various materials and compounds.

shelves.name: Radioactivity and Radon Measurements

shelves.name: Radiology practices and education

shelves.name: Radiomics and Machine Learning in Medical Imaging
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of radiomics, a quantitative analysis of medical images, particularly in the context of cancer imaging and precision medicine.

shelves.name: Radiopharmaceutical Chemistry and Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the development, synthesis, and application of radiopharmaceuticals for PET and SPECT imaging, targeted therapy, radioimmunotherapy, and alpha particle therapy in cancer treatment.

shelves.name: Railway Engineering and Dynamics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the dynamics of railway track and vehicles, including topics such as ground vibration, wheel-rail contact, high-speed trains, ballast behavior, dynamic interaction, track maintenance, vibration prediction, bridge dynamics, and rolling contact fatigue.

shelves.name: Railway Systems and Energy Efficiency
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the optimization of railway scheduling and operations, including train scheduling, railway timetabling, energy efficiency, traffic management, rescheduling algorithms, urban rail systems, regenerative braking, optimal control, passenger demand-oriented planning, and sustainable transportation.

shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the mechanical and thermal properties of nanocomposites, particularly those reinforced with graphene and carbon nanotubes.

shelves.name: Railways and European Transport Policy

shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the control and manipulation of light waves in complex and disordered media, including random lasers, ghost imaging, Anderson localization, wavefront shaping, and single-pixel imaging.

shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the biogeochemical cycling, management practices, and physiological responses of turfgrasses, particularly in relation to nitrogen leaching, drought resistance, soil temperatures, fertilizer effects on water quality, and heat stress tolerance.

shelves.name: Turkey's Politics and Society
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the multifaceted transformation of political, social, and economic landscapes in Turkey, with a focus on the rise of the AKP, increasing authoritarianism, Islam's role in public life, Kurdish question, neoliberal policies, gender politics, nationalism, European integration, and civil society dynamics.

shelves.name: Turkic and Altaic Linguistics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics in the field of Turkic linguistics, including language contact, morphology, historical phonology, oral epics, syntax, etymology, typology, and manuscriptology.

shelves.name: Turkish Literature and Culture
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the literature, poetry, and cultural heritage of the Ottoman Empire, particularly highlighting the significance of Divan poetry, Sufism, and classical Turkish literature.

shelves.name: Turkish Urban and Social Issues
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to urban studies, social policy analysis, and demographic transition.

shelves.name: Turtle Biology and Conservation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the conservation and management of marine turtles worldwide, with an emphasis on understanding the impacts of fisheries bycatch, satellite tracking, climate change, nesting habitat, population dynamics, sea-level rise, thermal conditions, and genetic structure.

shelves.name: Twentieth Century Scientific Developments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of science and technology with the geopolitical and ideological dynamics of the Cold War era.

shelves.name: UAV Applications and Optimization
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the communication, networking, and applications of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), covering topics such as wireless communications, trajectory optimization, energy-efficient communication, 5G and beyond, drone applications in various fields including disaster management and precision agriculture, mobile edge computing, security and privacy aspects, and integration with IoT.

shelves.name: Ubiquitin and proteasome pathways
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the Ubiquitin-Proteasome Proteolytic Pathway, exploring mechanisms of protein degradation, regulation of E3 Ubiquitin Ligases, roles of Deubiquitinating Enzymes, and the impact of SUMOylation.

shelves.name: Ukraine: War, Education, Health
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of interdisciplinary topics related to the Anthropocene epoch, including its geological impact, population trends, climate change, education challenges, neuroscience research, migration patterns, and sustainability efforts.

shelves.name: Ukrainian Cultural and Linguistic Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to international relations, cross-cultural interactions, sustainability, global governance, and education innovation.

shelves.name: Ukrainian Legal and Forensic Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to legal regulation in the global society, including human rights, environmental information, digital economy, forensic science, intellectual property, criminal liability, corruption prevention, and international cooperation.

shelves.name: Ultra-Wideband Communications Technology
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the technology, applications, and challenges of ultra-wideband (UWB) communications, including wireless multiple-access, propagation channel modeling, time-hopping impulse radio, and performance evaluation of UWB systems in various environments.

shelves.name: Ultrasonics and Acoustic Wave Propagation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of guided wave structural health monitoring techniques, particularly using piezoelectric sensors and ultrasonic arrays, for damage detection and assessment in composite structures.

shelves.name: Ultrasound and Cavitation Phenomena
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the diverse applications of ultrasound, including sonochemistry and cavitation, in the synthesis and fabrication of nanostructured materials.

shelves.name: Ultrasound and Hyperthermia Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the advancements in focused ultrasound technology and its diverse applications, including blood-brain barrier disruption, hyperthermia in cancer treatment, microbubble-mediated drug delivery, MRI-guided therapies, and noninvasive treatments for various conditions.

shelves.name: Ultrasound Imaging and Elastography
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the advancements in ultrasound elastography techniques for imaging tissue elasticity, including shear wave imaging and acoustic radiation force impulse imaging.

shelves.name: Ultrasound in Clinical Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the role of lung ultrasound, particularly in critical care settings, for diagnosing conditions such as pneumothorax, pulmonary edema, and COVID-19 pneumonia.

shelves.name: Umberto Eco and Semiotics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the interdisciplinary nature of semiotics, knowledge representation, and cultural studies.

shelves.name: Undergraduate Neuroscience Education and Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the challenges and innovations in undergraduate neuroscience education, covering topics such as curriculum development, research opportunities, faculty development, neuroanatomy teaching, and the use of simulations and online learning.

shelves.name: Underground infrastructure and sustainability
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the development, sustainable management, and utilization of urban underground space, with an emphasis on sustainable development, utility tunnels, spatial planning, subsurface resources, infrastructure, and resilience.

shelves.name: Underwater Acoustics Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the use of multiscale acoustic and machine learning techniques for mapping and classifying the seafloor, including habitat classification, bathymetry data analysis, geoacoustic inversion, and the study of marine sediments.

shelves.name: Underwater Vehicles and Communication Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the research challenges, advancements, and applications in underwater acoustic sensor networks and communication.

shelves.name: Unemployment and Economic Growth
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the robustness and applicability of Okun's Law in macroeconomics, particularly its relationship with unemployment, output, and economic growth across different countries.

shelves.name: University Challenges and Reforms
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the future of higher education in the context of neoliberalism, digital transformation, globalization, and the challenges of democracy.

shelves.name: University Extension and Social Responsibility
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of University Social Responsibility and its implementation in higher education institutions.

shelves.name: University-Industry-Government Innovation Models
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of Quadruple Helix innovation ecosystems, emphasizing the interplay between academia, industry, government, and society in knowledge production and regional innovation systems.

shelves.name: Urban Agriculture and Sustainability
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the multifaceted role of urban agriculture and community gardens in promoting food security, sustainability, and social capital in urban areas.

shelves.name: Urban and Freight Transport Logistics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the challenges and innovations in urban logistics systems, with a focus on last mile delivery, city logistics, urban freight transport, e-commerce, sustainability, crowdsourcing, supply chain, parcel lockers, transportation modeling, and environmental impacts.

shelves.name: Urban and Rural Development Challenges
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the challenges and complexities of urban poverty, slum upgrading, housing policy, informal settlements, and sustainable development in developing countries.

shelves.name: Urban and sociocultural dynamics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores urban ethnography, social dynamics, and cultural identity within the context of globalization, youth culture, and public space.

shelves.name: Urban and spatial planning

shelves.name: Urban Arborization and Environmental Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the study and management of urban greenery, including arborization, green areas, and public spaces.

shelves.name: Urban Design and Spatial Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the analysis, modeling, and visualization of urban street networks using methods such as Space Syntax and spatial analysis.

shelves.name: Urban Development and Cultural Heritage
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of sustainable urban development, cultural heritage preservation, and community participation.

shelves.name: Urban Development and Societal Issues
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the urban geography, social development, and territorial dynamics in Brazil, focusing on issues such as urbanization, social movements, sustainability, segregation, rural development, environmental justice, spatial planning, globalization, and public policy.

shelves.name: Urban Green Space and Health
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of urban green space on public health, emphasizing the relationship between nature contact, biodiversity conservation, and mental wellbeing.

shelves.name: Urban Heat Island Mitigation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the phenomenon of urban heat islands, the impact of urbanization and land-use change on climate, and various strategies to mitigate the heat island effect in urban environments.

shelves.name: Urban Planning and Governance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of neoliberal urban policies, gentrification, and globalization on cities.

shelves.name: Urban Planning and Landscape Design
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of ecological wisdom and its application in urban planning and design, with a focus on sustainability, ecosystem services, and socio-ecological practice.

shelves.name: Urban Planning and Valuation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on sustainable urban development and planning, with an emphasis on topics such as transferable development rights, sustainability, urban regeneration, public-private partnerships, economic evaluation, cultural heritage, spatial decision support systems, multi-criteria analysis, real estate market dynamics, and land use.

shelves.name: Urban Stormwater Management Solutions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on urban stormwater management, sustainable drainage systems, and the impact of urbanization on hydrology and water quality.

shelves.name: Urban Transport and Accessibility
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the influence of the built environment on active travel, focusing on factors such as neighborhood walkability, accessibility, and environmental correlates.

shelves.name: Urban Transport Systems Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the planning, modeling, and management of transportation systems, with an emphasis on digital technologies, quality management, urban traffic, dependability, infrastructure, logistics, and cyber security.

shelves.name: Urban, Neighborhood, and Segregation Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of residential segregation on communities and individuals, focusing on topics such as neighborhood effects, social mobility, racial segregation, housing discrimination, urban poverty, immigrant enclaves, family migration, and spatial assimilation.

shelves.name: Urbanism, Landscape, and Tourism Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of cultural landscapes, tourism development, and territorial heritage, with a focus on topics such as industrial heritage, rural tourism, historical land use, community engagement, and environmental conservation.

shelves.name: Urbanization and City Planning
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the phenomenon of urban shrinkage, particularly in post-socialist contexts, analyzing the causes, effects, and policy responses to population loss, vacant land management, suburbanization, and socio-spatial disparities.

shelves.name: Ureteral procedures and complications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on obstetric vesicovaginal fistula and ureteral injuries, covering topics such as diagnosis, management, surgical techniques, public health implications, iatrogenic causes, and prevention strategies.

shelves.name: Urinary and Genital Oncology Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the clinical and pathological aspects of urachal carcinoma, including its diagnosis, management, and molecular characteristics.

shelves.name: Urinary Bladder and Prostate Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the standardization of terminology, diagnosis, and treatment of lower urinary tract function, with a specific emphasis on conditions such as lower urinary tract symptoms, benign prostatic hyperplasia, overactive bladder, and urinary incontinence.

shelves.name: Urinary Tract Infections Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the epidemiology, mechanisms of infection, treatment options, and antimicrobial resistance of urinary tract infections (UTIs).

shelves.name: Urologic and reproductive health conditions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the pathology, diagnosis, and management of genitourinary soft tissue tumors and anomalies, including aggressive angiomyxoma, prostatic tumors, seminal vesicle cysts, fibroepithelial polyps, ejaculatory duct obstruction, and associated conditions like hemospermia and acrochordon.

shelves.name: Urological Disorders and Treatments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to urotrauma, genitourinary development, and associated conditions such as hypospadias, urethral stricture disease, bladder exstrophy, endocrine disruption, and penile fracture.

shelves.name: Urticaria and Related Conditions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the diagnosis, classification, and management of urticaria, particularly chronic spontaneous urticaria.

shelves.name: Usability and User Interface Design
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the evaluation of usability in human-computer interaction, with an emphasis on user-centered design, mobile applications, cultural adaptation, and collaborative work.

shelves.name: User Authentication and Security Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores various user authentication methods and security measures, including biometrics, passwords, graphical passwords, continuous authentication, CAPTCHA, and their usability and effectiveness in securing mobile devices and online accounts.

shelves.name: Uterine Myomas and Treatments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on various aspects of uterine conditions and their treatments, including uterine leiomyoma (fibroids), hysterectomy, uterine sarcomas, uterine artery embolization, reproductive outcomes after different treatments, MRI guidance for treatment, the role of progesterone, and the impact on health-related quality of life.

shelves.name: Utopian, Dystopian, and Speculative Fiction
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the themes of utopia and dystopia in science fiction, with a focus on Afrofuturism, environmentalism, post-apocalyptic scenarios, feminism, Marxism, and colonialism.

shelves.name: Vaccine Coverage and Hesitancy
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the multifaceted issue of vaccine hesitancy, including its determinants, impact on immunization coverage, and implications for global health.

shelves.name: vaccines and immunoinformatics approaches
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the prediction of peptide-major histocompatibility complex (MHC) binding affinity, epitope prediction, and immunoinformatics for vaccine design.

shelves.name: Vacuum and Plasma Arcs
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the physics of vacuum arcs and thermal plasmas, including topics such as ion energy distribution, electrode erosion, magnetic field effects, transport properties, and their application in circuit breakers.

shelves.name: Vagus Nerve Stimulation Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the neuro-immune modulation achieved through vagus nerve stimulation, particularly its role in regulating inflammation, cholinergic antiinflammatory pathway, neural reflexes, and immunomodulation.

shelves.name: Value Engineering and Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on value management in the construction industry, with an emphasis on sustainability, knowledge management, risk management, teamwork productivity, and innovation.

shelves.name: Values and Moral Education
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on character education in schools, teacher training, and curriculum implementation.

shelves.name: Vanadium and Halogenation Chemistry
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the chemistry, biochemistry, and medicinal aspects of vanadium compounds, including their catalytic activities, oxidations, asymmetric synthesis, antidiabetic properties, halogenation reactions, and enantioselective processes.

shelves.name: Varied Academic Research Topics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of e-commerce, stakeholder analysis in higher education, and their impact on economic development.

shelves.name: Various Academic Research Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to research methods, educational interventions, social sciences, healthcare management, environmental impact, technology transfer, adolescent behavior, data collection techniques, knowledge management, and innovation policies.

shelves.name: Various Chemistry Research Topics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on innovations in chemistry education and laboratory techniques, including the use of virtual laboratories, primary literature, light-emitting diodes, smartphone applications, 3D printing, and green chemistry.

shelves.name: Vascular anomalies and interventions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on a wide range of venous anomalies and syndromes in the vascular system, including anomalies of the inferior vena cava, superior mesenteric artery syndrome, nutcracker syndrome, vascular compression syndromes, and venous aneurysms.

shelves.name: Vascular Malformations and Hemangiomas
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the classification, diagnosis, and treatment of vascular anomalies, including hemangiomas, vascular malformations, and lymphatic malformations.

shelves.name: Vascular Malformations Diagnosis and Treatment
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the management, natural history, genetic aspects, and treatment outcomes of vascular malformations in the brain, including arteriovenous malformations, cerebral cavernous malformations, and dural arteriovenous fistulas.

shelves.name: Vascular Procedures and Complications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on vascular access for coronary procedures, comparing radial and femoral approaches, as well as the management of vascular trauma and complications.

shelves.name: Vascular Tumors and Angiosarcomas
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the research and clinical aspects of vascular tumors, particularly angiosarcoma and epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.

shelves.name: Vasculitis and related conditions
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the classification, diagnosis, and management of various vasculitides, including ANCA-associated vasculitis, giant cell arteritis, polyarteritis nodosa, Churg-Strauss syndrome, and Takayasu arteritis.

shelves.name: Vector-Borne Animal Diseases
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the epidemiology, transmission, pathogenesis, and control strategies of Bluetongue virus, a vector-borne disease primarily transmitted by Culicoides biting midges.

shelves.name: Vector-borne infectious diseases
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the epidemiology, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of tick-borne diseases such as Lyme disease, babesiosis, anaplasmosis, and various rickettsioses.

shelves.name: Vehicle Dynamics and Control Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on advanced control systems for vehicle dynamics, including autonomous vehicles, model predictive control, estimation of tire-road friction, active steering, yaw stability control, and driver assistance.

shelves.name: Vehicle emissions and performance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on estimating vehicle fuel consumption and emissions, with an emphasis on real-world measurements, driving cycles, eco-driving, and the impact of traffic conditions on emission factors.

shelves.name: Vehicle License Plate Recognition
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the development and application of automatic license plate recognition systems, utilizing techniques such as deep learning, convolutional neural networks, and character segmentation.

shelves.name: Vehicle Noise and Vibration Control
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the control and analysis of noise and vibration in vehicles, particularly in relation to engine mounting systems.

shelves.name: Vehicle Routing Optimization Methods
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) and its variants, including topics such as heuristic algorithms, tabu search, dynamic programming, metaheuristics, time windows, large-scale optimization, green logistics, multi-depot routing, and hybrid algorithms.

shelves.name: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs)

shelves.name: Venezuelan Migration and Society
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the multifaceted impact of Venezuela's crisis on public health, migration, multiculturalism, and the economy.

shelves.name: Venomous Animal Envenomation and Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the evolution, composition, and effects of snake venoms, as well as the development of antivenom treatments.

shelves.name: Venous Thromboembolism Diagnosis and Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), including pulmonary embolism and deep vein thrombosis.

shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to equine health and welfare, including studies on laminitis, horse nutrition, stress assessment, genetics, injuries, obesity, and behaviour.

shelves.name: Veterinary Medicine and Surgery

shelves.name: Veterinary Oncology Research

shelves.name: Veterinary Orthopedics and Neurology
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on orthopedic studies in canine veterinary medicine, covering topics such as osteoarthritis, surgical complications, joint diseases, gait analysis, spinal cord injuries, pain assessment, limb function, and treatment outcomes.

shelves.name: Veterinary Pharmacology and Anesthesia
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on pain management, anesthesia, and welfare assessment in laboratory animals, with a specific emphasis on the use of tramadol, pharmacokinetics of analgesic drugs, behavioral assessment of pain, and postoperative pain management.

shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the mental health and well-being of veterinary professionals, addressing topics such as suicide risk, work-related stress, veterinarian-client communication, occupational hazards, burnout, professional competencies, and resilience.

shelves.name: Vibration and Dynamic Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the analysis and control of axially moving dynamics, including vibration analysis, nonlinear dynamics, and stability analysis of fluid-conveying pipes, cable dynamics, and viscoelastic beams.

shelves.name: Vibration Control and Rheological Fluids
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the advances in structural vibration control systems, including the use of magnetorheological fluids, passive and active vibration isolators, nonlinear energy sinks, tuned mass dampers, inerter-based devices, electrorheological fluids, vibration absorbers, smart material composites, and seismic control.

shelves.name: Vibrio bacteria research studies

shelves.name: Video Analysis and Summarization

shelves.name: Video Coding and Compression Technologies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers encompasses advancements in video coding standards and techniques, including H.264/AVC, High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC), Scalable Video Coding, motion estimation algorithms, depth image-based rendering for 3D-TV, and error resilience techniques.

shelves.name: Video Surveillance and Tracking Methods
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on visual object tracking and person re-identification, covering topics such as background subtraction, convolutional neural networks, real-time tracking, deep learning, foreground segmentation, multiple object tracking, and motion detection.

shelves.name: Vietnamese History and Culture Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the social, cultural, and historical development of Vietnam, focusing on topics such as gender practices, colonialism, religious traditions, political dynamics, and economic transitions.

shelves.name: Viking Age and Medieval Scandinavia
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores various aspects of the Viking Age, including diaspora, identity, settlements, material culture, religion, and cultural exchange in Scandinavia and neighboring regions.

shelves.name: Violence, Education, and Gender Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to knowledge management, education, innovation, and their impact on society.

shelves.name: Violence, Religion, and Philosophy

shelves.name: Viral gastroenteritis research and epidemiology
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the epidemiology, pathogenesis, and vaccine development for gastrointestinal viral infections, particularly rotavirus and norovirus.

shelves.name: Viral Infections and Immunology Research

shelves.name: Viral Infections and Outbreaks Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers encompasses research on the Ebola virus, including its transmission, pathogenesis, genomic surveillance, vaccine development, and the impact of public health measures.

shelves.name: Viral Infections and Vectors

shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the production of recombinant proteins, particularly in mammalian and insect cells.

shelves.name: Viral-associated cancers and disorders

shelves.name: Virology and Viral Diseases

shelves.name: Virtual Reality Applications and Impacts
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of virtual presence and embodiment in virtual reality (VR) research.

shelves.name: Virus-based gene therapy research

shelves.name: Visual and Cognitive Learning Processes
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on Cognitive Load Theory and its application in multimedia learning, instructional design, and educational technology.

shelves.name: Visual Attention and Saliency Detection
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on computational modeling and detection of visual saliency, including topics such as saliency detection, visual attention, deep learning for salient object detection, analysis of eye movements, image and video segmentation, and the interplay between bottom-up and top-down attention mechanisms.

shelves.name: Visual Culture and Art Theory
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the interdisciplinary study of visual representation and communication, encompassing topics such as visual culture, intermediality, ekphrasis, iconic turn, media studies, sensory studies, cultural studies, art history, semiotics, and photography.

shelves.name: Visual perception and processing mechanisms
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the neural mechanisms underlying visual perception, including topics such as perceptual learning, cortical connectivity, sensory integration, retinotopic mapping, motion processing, binocular vision, neuronal adaptation, and psychophysical function.

shelves.name: Vitamin C and Antioxidants Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the diverse roles of Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid, in health and disease.

shelves.name: Vitamin D Research Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the evaluation, treatment, and prevention of vitamin D deficiency, as well as its impact on various health outcomes such as bone health, cancer, cardiovascular disease, and the immune system.

shelves.name: Vitamin K Research Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the role of Vitamin K in various aspects of health, including bone health, prevention of fractures, regulation of vascular calcification, and its association with chronic diseases.

shelves.name: Vladimir Nabokov Literary Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the dynamics of cultural identity, social systems, and the impact of global transformations on indigenous peoples.

shelves.name: VLSI and Analog Circuit Testing
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on various aspects of testing Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) circuits, including techniques such as test data compression, embedded cores testing, scan testing, analog circuit fault diagnosis, BIST schemes, test access architectures, low-power testing, and delay fault testing.

shelves.name: VLSI and FPGA Design Techniques

shelves.name: Vocational and Entrepreneurial Education

shelves.name: Vocational Education and Training

shelves.name: Voice and Speech Disorders

shelves.name: Walter Benjamin Studies Compilation

shelves.name: War, Ethics, and Justification

shelves.name: War, Law, and Justice

shelves.name: Waste Management and Environmental Impact

shelves.name: Waste Management and Recycling
