shelves.name: Wastewater Treatment and Nitrogen Removal
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the microbial nitrogen cycle in biological wastewater treatment systems, including the roles of nitrifying and denitrifying bacteria, anammox bacteria, and extracellular polymeric substances.

shelves.name: Wastewater Treatment and Reuse
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the various aspects of wastewater reuse, including its benefits, risks, and management practices.

shelves.name: Water and Land Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to environmental conservation and sustainable development, including soil health, garbage enzyme, zeolites, land reclamation, water management, erosion control, biodiversity, and climate change.

shelves.name: Water and Wastewater Treatment
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics in science and technology, including renewable energy, climate change, agricultural technology, nanomaterial synthesis, economic impact, genetic diversity, water management, innovation ecosystem, digital economy, and environmental sustainability.

shelves.name: Water Governance and Infrastructure
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intricate politics, poetics, and governance of water infrastructure, delving into issues such as water privatization, urban political ecology, neoliberalism's impact on nature, water justice, and the hydrosocial cycle.

shelves.name: Water management and technologies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the evolution and historical development of water management, wastewater technologies, and urban water supply systems in ancient civilizations.

shelves.name: Water Quality and Pollution Assessment
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the assessment of surface water quality, utilizing multivariate statistical techniques, water quality indices, and spatial and temporal variations analysis.

shelves.name: Water Quality and Resources Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to water quality, hydrogeology, sediment analysis, and environmental impact assessment.

shelves.name: Water Quality Monitoring and Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the on-line monitoring and assessment of wastewater quality using advanced techniques such as UV-VIS spectroscopy, chemical oxygen demand measurement, and sensor fusion.

shelves.name: Water Quality Monitoring Technologies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on real-time monitoring of water quality, aquaculture management, and environmental sensing using advanced technologies such as sensor networks, IoT, and computer vision.

shelves.name: Water Resource Management and Quality
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on water governance, sustainability management, and environmental health, with an emphasis on community participation, ecosystem conservation, and public policy in the context of rural water systems.

shelves.name: Water Resources and Governance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on human rights, legal frameworks, and international law, addressing issues such as social justice, equality, civil liberties, ethical challenges, global governance, racial discrimination, and economic justice.

shelves.name: Water Resources and Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the environmental impact, ecological changes, and water quality issues in the Lake Baikal ecosystem, particularly in relation to climate change, sediment transport, nutrient emissions, and land-use changes in the Selenga River Basin.

shelves.name: Water Resources and Sustainability
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the development and application of the Water Poverty Index, carrying capacity assessment, water resources sustainability, urban development, ecological environment evaluation, and system dynamics modeling.

shelves.name: Water resources management and optimization
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the optimal operation and management of water resources systems, addressing challenges such as reservoir operation, water demand forecasting, climate change impacts, sustainability, hydro-economic modeling, urbanization effects, system dynamics applications, robust decision making, and groundwater management.

shelves.name: Water Systems and Optimization
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the design, management, and optimization of water distribution networks.

shelves.name: Water Treatment and Disinfection
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the occurrence, genotoxicity, and carcinogenicity of disinfection by-products (DBPs) in drinking water, with a specific emphasis on the effects of chlorination and alternative disinfectants.

shelves.name: Water-Energy-Food Nexus Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the interconnectedness of water, energy, and food resources, with a focus on integrated modeling, sustainability, and the impact of climate change.

shelves.name: Wave and Wind Energy Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a comprehensive review and analysis of wave energy conversion technologies, including power take-off systems, offshore wind integration, control strategies, and hydrodynamic modeling.

shelves.name: Web and Library Services
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of Web 2.0 technologies, social media, and digital trends on academic libraries, focusing on topics such as Library 2.0, information services, library marketing, and user engagement.

shelves.name: Web Application Security Vulnerabilities
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the security of web applications, particularly in detecting and preventing vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting.

shelves.name: Web Applications and Data Management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the engineering and development of web applications, with an emphasis on model-driven approaches, conceptual modeling, rich internet applications, and adaptive web systems.

shelves.name: Web Data Mining and Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on techniques and technologies for extracting structured data from web pages, including web crawling, automatic wrapper generation, page segmentation, and mining data records.

shelves.name: Web visibility and informetrics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the quantitative analysis of web presence, hyperlink structures, and impact factors of academic institutions and research publications.

shelves.name: Weber, Simmel, Sociological Theory
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers revolves around the contributions of Max Weber to sociology and social theory.

shelves.name: Weed Control and Herbicide Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on weed management, herbicide resistance, and the impact of herbicides on crop losses.

shelves.name: Welding Techniques and Residual Stresses
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on various welding techniques, including laser welding, gas tungsten arc welding, and electron beam welding.

shelves.name: Wetland Management and Conservation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the use of unmanned aerial vehicles, robotics, and information technology for disaster response, environmental management, and climate change adaptation.

shelves.name: Wheat and Barley Genetics and Pathology
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the genetic diversity, breeding, and genomics of wheat, with an emphasis on disease resistance, yield potential, polyploid wheat, QTL mapping, and genome sequencing.

shelves.name: Whipple's Disease and Interleukins
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the pathogenesis, diagnosis, and treatment of Whipple's disease, caused by the bacterium Tropheryma whipplei.

shelves.name: Whitehead's Philosophy and Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers revolves around the interdisciplinary field of Green Economics, focusing on sustainability, environmental social science, climate change, civil commons, globalization, anti-capitalism, ecofeminism, corporate governance, and social justice.

shelves.name: Wikis in Education and Collaboration
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the collaboration, dynamics, and information quality within the context of Wikipedia.

shelves.name: Wildlife Conservation and Criminology Analyses
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the illegal trade and conservation issues related to parrots, including topics such as parrot poaching, wildlife trafficking, invasive species, state-corporate crime, ecological harm, and nest competition.

shelves.name: Wildlife Ecology and Conservation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics in wildlife ecology and conservation biology, including estimating occupancy rates, analyzing animal movement patterns, trophic cascades, habitat selection, population dynamics of large herbivores and carnivores, human-wildlife conflict, camera trapping for wildlife monitoring, and strategies for conservation management.

shelves.name: Wildlife-Road Interactions and Conservation
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the ecological effects of roads on wildlife, including habitat connectivity, wildlife mortality, landscape fragmentation, and conservation planning.

shelves.name: Williams Syndrome Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the genetic, neurodevelopmental, cognitive, and behavioral aspects of Williams Syndrome.

shelves.name: Wind and Air Flow Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the modeling and simulation of urban wind environments, air quality, and atmospheric dispersion.

shelves.name: Wind Energy Research and Development
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on wind energy technology, including topics such as wind turbine wakes, renewable energy sustainability indicators, Weibull distribution for wind speed analysis, offshore wind farms, tidal energy conversion systems, blade design, wind farm optimization, CFD simulation for aerodynamics, and environmental impact assessment.

shelves.name: Wind Turbine Control Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the integration of wind power into power systems, with a specific emphasis on the use of Doubly Fed Induction Generators, power electronics, and control strategies.

shelves.name: Wine Industry and Tourism
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the factors influencing wine tourism, consumer behavior, and wine choice.

shelves.name: Winter Sports Injuries and Performance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the analysis of injuries, risk factors, and safety measures in alpine skiing and snowboarding.

shelves.name: Wireless Body Area Networks
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the use of Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) in healthcare, covering topics such as implantable antennas, health monitoring, security and privacy of implantable medical devices, intrabody communication, MAC protocols, biotelemetry, channel modeling, and wearable sensors.

shelves.name: Wireless Communication Networks Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on efficient power control, resource allocation, and interference suppression techniques in wireless networks, particularly CDMA systems.

shelves.name: Wireless Communication Security Techniques
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of physical layer security techniques in wireless communications, with an emphasis on secrecy capacity, cooperative relaying, and the use of artificial noise to enhance security.

shelves.name: Wireless Networks and Protocols
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the performance analysis, optimization, and enhancement of medium access control (MAC) protocols for wireless LANs, particularly the IEEE 802.11 standard.

shelves.name: Wireless Power Transfer Systems
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the analysis, design, and optimization of wireless power transfer systems, with applications in electric vehicle charging, biomedical implants, and contactless power transmission.

shelves.name: Wireless Sensor Networks and IoT
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of wireless sensor networks, Internet of Things, and related technologies in various domains such as smart home systems, urban transportation, remote monitoring, and data mining.

shelves.name: Wireless Sensor Networks for Data Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the use of wireless sensor networks, mobile devices, and biotelemetry for data analysis, health monitoring, and environmental sensing.

shelves.name: Wireless Signal Modulation Classification
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the application of deep learning techniques for wireless signal classification, including modulation classification, channel estimation, RF fingerprinting, and spectrum monitoring in cognitive radios.

shelves.name: Wittgensteinian philosophy and applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers revolves around the philosophy of Ludwig Wittgenstein, particularly focusing on language-games, ethics, education, certainty, religion, grammar, meaning, and contextualism.

shelves.name: Wnt/β-catenin signaling in development and cancer
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the Wnt signaling pathway and its role in development, stem cells, cancer, and disease.

shelves.name: Women's cancer prevention and management
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and psychosocial impact of cervical cancer and breast cancer in women.

shelves.name: Wood and Agarwood Research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the chemical constituents, production techniques, and pharmacological activities of agarwood derived from Aquilaria species.

shelves.name: Wood Residue Utilization and Solid Biofuels
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the utilization of forest biomass, including wood residues, for various applications such as bioenergy generation, value-added products, and sustainable production.

shelves.name: Wood Treatment and Properties
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to advancements in wood science and technology, including wood chemistry, FTIR analysis, heat treatment effects, timber construction, microstructure analysis, wood modification techniques, mechanical properties of wood, thermal modification processes, fungal decay of wood, and nanomechanical studies.

shelves.name: Work-Family Balance Challenges
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intricate dynamics of work and family interactions, including work-family conflict, telecommuting, gender inequality, family supportive policies, flexible work arrangements, parental leave, remote working, job satisfaction, gender roles, and work-life balance.

shelves.name: Workaholism, burnout, and well-being
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the dimensions, antecedents, and consequences of workaholism, including its relationship with job demands, well-being, personality traits, coping strategies, and organizational culture.

shelves.name: Working Capital and Financial Performance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of working capital management, particularly trade credit, on the profitability and financial performance of firms, with a focus on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

shelves.name: Workplace Health and Well-being
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the impact of work-related stress, psychosocial work environment, and job strain on employee health, including sickness presenteeism, absenteeism, and the development of depressive symptoms.

shelves.name: Workplace Spirituality and Leadership
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of spirituality, leadership, and organizational performance in the workplace.

shelves.name: Workplace Violence and Bullying
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the prevalence, impact, and consequences of workplace bullying and harassment, particularly in professional environments such as nursing.

shelves.name: World Systems and Global Transformations
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers revolves around the analysis of world-systems, globalization, economic development, dependency, and inequality.

shelves.name: World Trade Organization Law
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the role of public international law in the World Trade Organization (WTO) disputes, including topics such as WTO dispute settlement, global governance, trade policy, human rights, environmental regulation, developing country participation, and the constitutionalization of international trade law.

shelves.name: World Wars: History, Literature, and Impact
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to the global impact of World Wars, international relations, League of Nations, cultural memory, military history, colonialism, humanitarianism, gender roles, and psychological trauma.

shelves.name: Wound Healing and Treatments
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers a wide range of topics related to wound healing and regeneration, including the role of macrophages and fibroblasts, chronic wounds, growth factors, hydrogel dressings, angiogenesis, diabetes, and inflammation.

shelves.name: Writing and Handwriting Education
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on effective strategies for writing instruction in education, including handwriting development, self-regulated strategy development, meta-analyses of writing interventions, and the impact of writing on learning and academic achievement.

shelves.name: X-ray Diffraction in Crystallography
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the advances in powder diffraction analysis, including topics such as crystallography, structure determination, pair distribution function, nanoparticles, Rietveld refinement, total scattering, high-resolution X-ray diffraction, and quantitative phase analysis.

shelves.name: X-ray Spectroscopy and Fluorescence Analysis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers covers advancements in X-ray absorption spectroscopy, including theoretical calculations, high-resolution techniques, and applications to transition metal complexes.

shelves.name: Xenotransplantation and immune response
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on xenotransplantation, particularly the use of pigs as organ donors for human transplantation.

shelves.name: Yeasts and Rust Fungi Studies
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the diversity, systematics, and ecological roles of yeasts, including their phylogenetic relationships, molecular mapping, biogeography, and epidemiology.

shelves.name: Yersinia bacterium, plague, ectoparasites research
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the genetic and pathogenic study of Yersinia pestis, the causative agent of plague.

shelves.name: Youth Culture and Social Dynamics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the emergence of youth cultures, strategies of disenchantment, cultural hybridity, and the impact of globalization on social identity.

shelves.name: Youth Development and Social Support
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the concept of positive youth development, focusing on the impact of youth development programs, extracurricular activities, and community engagement on adolescent development.

shelves.name: Youth Education and Societal Dynamics
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the complex and multifaceted nature of youth transitions, focusing on issues such as social exclusion, individualization, NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training), longitudinal research, adulthood, agency, class dynamics, generational differences, and the impact of the risk society.

shelves.name: Youth Substance Use and School Attendance
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the complex issue of school absenteeism, including truancy and social withdrawal behaviors such as hikikomori, among children and adolescents.

shelves.name: Youth, Drugs, and Violence
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the patterns and impacts of drug use, with a focus on cocaine and crack, among adolescents and adults in Brazil.

shelves.name: Youth, Politics, and Society
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the intersection of youth, public policy, and social change in Brazil.

shelves.name: Zebrafish Biomedical Research Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers encompasses a wide range of research using zebrafish as a model organism, including studies on developmental biology, behavioral analysis, drug discovery, hematopoiesis, neuroscience, toxicology, and vascular development.

shelves.name: Zeolite Catalysis and Synthesis
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the synthesis, characterization, and applications of zeolites in catalysis, with a particular emphasis on mesoporous and hierarchical zeolite materials.

shelves.name: Ziziphus Jujuba Studies and Applications
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the nutritional composition, health benefits, and bioactive compounds of Jujube (Ziziphus jujuba) fruit.

shelves.name: ZnO doping and properties
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the synthesis, properties, and applications of zinc oxide (ZnO) nanostructures, focusing on its use in semiconductors, photodetectors, optoelectronics, and transparent conductors.

shelves.name: Zoonotic diseases and public health
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers focuses on the emergence, transmission, and impact of zoonotic diseases, highlighting the interconnectedness of human, animal, and environmental health.

shelves.name: Zygmunt Bauman's Sociology
shelves.scope: This cluster of papers explores the impact of liquid modernity on society and culture, addressing topics such as globalization, ethics, identity, inequality, and the workforce.

shelves.name: Folklore
shelves.scope: Folklore: traditional tales, beliefs, customs and oral traditions.

shelves.name: Recreation. Leisure
shelves.scope: Recreation and leisure: sports, games, dance, outdoor recreation and amusements.

shelves.scope: Social pathology, social and public welfare and criminology: crime, punishment, poverty and relief.

shelves.name: Print media
shelves.scope: Print media: the print-making arts such as engraving, etching, woodcut and lithography.

shelves.name: Decorative arts
shelves.scope: Decorative arts: ceramics, glass, furniture, metalwork, textiles and ornament.

shelves.name: Aquaculture. Fisheries. Angling
shelves.scope: Aquaculture, fisheries and angling: raising and catching fish and other aquatic animals.

shelves.name: Hunting sports
shelves.scope: Hunting as a sport: methods, equipment and the pursuit of game animals.

shelves.name: Photography
shelves.scope: Photography: the making of photographs and the processes and equipment it uses.

shelves.name: Manufactures
shelves.scope: Manufactures: the making of goods, including textiles, clothing, leather, wood and metal products.

shelves.name: Handicrafts. Arts and crafts
shelves.scope: Handicrafts and the arts and crafts: making things by hand.

shelves.name: Home economics
shelves.scope: Home economics: cooking, nutrition, household management and homemaking.

shelves.name: Military science (General)
shelves.scope: Military science in general: the organization, strategy and conduct of armed forces.

shelves.name: Maintenance and transportation
shelves.scope: Maintenance and transportation of armed forces: supply, logistics and military transport.

shelves.name: Military engineering. Air forces
shelves.scope: Military engineering and air forces: fortification, field engineering and military aviation.

shelves.name: Naval science (General)
shelves.scope: Naval science in general: the organization and conduct of navies.

shelves.scope: Navigation and the merchant marine: finding and keeping a course at sea, and commercial shipping.

shelves.name: Naval architecture. Shipbuilding. Marine engineering
shelves.scope: Naval architecture, shipbuilding and marine engineering: the design and construction of ships and their machinery.
